title: Japanese-Style Roast Turkey Breast
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese-inspired roast turkey breast dish. Perfect for special occasions or holidays.
instructions: Rinse the turkey breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, and grated ginger.
Place the turkey breast in a roasting pan and brush the soy sauce mixture evenly over both sides of the turkey.
Sprinkle the zesty roast, canadian bacon, and green onions over the turkey.
Roast the turkey in the preheated oven for 30 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Remove the turkey from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the turkey before serving.
